forEveryone.text:
built for anyone, used by me first
• nothing is tied to one person's projects
• projects, $ commands, hosts, devices, agents, entry kinds, recipes and rules all come from settings
• the sample data on these boards is only sample data
• a new user: install the desktop app, pair a phone by qr, point it at a folder of repos — that's it

carryBack.text:
carry every decision back into the app
• a decision on this canvas changes what cellar already has too, not only the new desk parts
• e.g. agent questions on entries (inbox › waiting on you, asked through cellar_ask) get the same question card: lettered options, pick several, and a note with any answer — and the note travels back to the agent through the mcp tools
• same idea for the rest: approvals sit beside questions in the inbox, kinds get their recipes, the old profile page's leftovers move into settings
• when building something here, list the existing screens and tools it touches and update them in the same change

sMain.text:
desk tab — logic
• right nav plate = host; badge counts available questions + approvals
• waiting first, above the host: entry questions + run approvals, across all projects; open their context to answer
• title = paired PC name + monitor icon; generic your desk before pairing
• connection state below title beside available global working/waiting counts; paired name stays during reconnect
• compact panel: slots + screen action, route/latency/freshness, expandable cpu/memory; no duplicate identity/state; unavailable screen keeps its reason
• commands for: project chips change tiles; separate run filter defaults to all projects and narrows working/lately only
• shared visible state word: working (internal running unchanged)
• reasons have two lines; 16px top content gap after safe area and side gutters; 44px controls; final content clears floating nav
• busy, connecting, connected run-load error, disconnected, unpaired, no projects, no runs states
• disconnected/connecting hide PC runs, blockers/counts, metrics, commands, paths and builds; retain host recovery and local navigation
• run-load failure with verified connection preserves independent commands/screen; no invented run/slot totals; retry only runs
• mobile chat-plus is the only new-task action; empty states have no duplicate CTA
• page recovery actions fill content width, min 48px high, 8px corners; command grid stays
• tall task sheet opens immediately
• settings top right; tap a run to open its chat
• revision 5 confirmed 2026-10-10; skip on resume; app implementation pending; see updates.md

sNewTask.text:
new task — revision 2 · confirmed 2026-10-10
• original centered editable transcript + inline colours; circular 76px primary and 48px side controls
• keyboard primary by default, microphone beside it; voice tap swaps icons/roles and adds waveform above input; typing hides waveform
• always tall; pinned header/close and bottom send; keyboard only reduces body
• send to michu-pc; always one task/run here; no run counts, split controls, summary strip or run monitor
• multiple thoughts are context for one selected-project task; resolve mismatches
• project: attached thoughts → Main commands → explicit choice
• defaults: project → kind recipe → global; preserve explicit overrides
• new worktree from project default branch; workspace and permissions independent; unavailable choices never silently substitute
• autosave/resume/new; preserve incoming context until choice
• validation, voice fallback, rejection/retry, original-receipt check and folder trust
• host confirms start → Run chat; no started-runs list inside NewTask
• external controls simulate voice/host; 320/390/560px previews; app untouched
• NEW-R2 overrides earlier batching decisions for this page; confirmed by user “next”; skip on resume; see updates.md

sRun.text:
run chat — revision 1 · awaiting review
• pinned title, working/waiting state + PC connection; tap for workspace, files and separate Preview
• measured chat/dock; keyboard clears nav; new messages preserve reading position
• shared composer frame: text above; transparent plus → File/Image tray; voice + model/reasoning + Send below
• no symbol strip or dispatch choices; typed @ $ / still search
• Send always queues during a turn; queue popout Send now interrupts current tool then continues; edit/cancel need PC confirmation
• model/effort saved per message; attachments wait for upload confirmation; rejected/unknown sends retain draft and original receipt
• approvals + linked questions replace composer; allow once primary, run scope under More; first answer wins
• Continue uses same chat/workspace; stop final only after host reply
• disconnected hides live progress; View history shows saved chat + timestamp
• all PC/model/upload/voice replies simulated; app gaps in updates.md

sPreview.text:
preview — logic
• the dev server runs on the host; the phone opens it over the tailnet in a webview
• size chips resize it to phone / tablet / desktop
• checks = the project's own check commands
• deploy = the project's $deploy; 'tell the agent' adds a follow-up to the same run

sScreen.text:
live screen — logic
• its own video channel, never mixed into run events
• the host asks first, unless this phone is trusted
• modes: touch (tap = click), trackpad, keyboard, dictate into the focused field
• leaving the screen ends the stream

sNotify.text:
notifications — logic
• one per run, updated in place (plan 3 of 5)
• approvals: up to 3 buttons (android's limit)
• questions: first 2 options + 'more'; inline reply = 'other'
• follow you: desktop in use → desk only; idle 5 min or locked → phone; unanswered on the desk 2 min → phone
• never on two devices at once; the other just updates its badge

sQuestion.text:
agent questions — logic
• structured questions (claude's AskUserQuestion, codex's input requests) arrive as question + options + single/multi
• rendered as lettered cards, never a text blob
• a plain-text 'A) … B) …' list is parsed into cards too
• 'other' is always there — type or say it
• answer by tap, voice ('B', 'the second one') or notification

sShare.text:
share + crashes — logic
• cellar is a share target for images, text and links
• kind guessed: screenshot → glitch, link → research, text → idea
• 'hand it off' runs that kind's recipe
• crashes of your debug builds (adb logcat or your own reporter) file a glitch with stack, screenshot and 200 log lines
• the same stack again bumps a counter instead of a new entry

sRace.text:
race mode — logic
• one prompt, two runs: two agents, or one agent on two models
• each in its own worktree off the same commit
• compare: checks, diff size, time, usage, previews
• pick → the winner's branch stays; the loser's worktree is deleted, its chat kept 7 days

sNight.text:
night shift — logic
• tasks marked 'tonight' queue up during the day
• they run in a set window on a chosen host
• full access only inside their own worktree; nothing that ships runs at night
• stops early to leave usage for the morning
• digest at a set time: keep, toss or follow up per run

sDeskHome.text:
home — logic
• one capture bar: enter files a thought, shift+enter hands it to an agent
• waiting on you answers inline
• devices: every host and phone, live
• tiles: the selected project's $ commands
• stop all agents = interrupt every run on every host

sDeskChat.text:
chat — logic
• runs grouped by project, what needs you first
• keys: @ files; $ commands, or $project/ then its entries; / the picked agent's skills; hex → colour chip
• the agent picker decides which / skills are listed
• right rail: attached phone + this run's files, checkpoints, preview
• header meter: context + 5h/week use (see usage)

sDeskProjects.text:
project board — logic
• cellar's three views: by kind, one stream, board
• columns = entry states; badges show which agent claimed what
• tick entries → one run, or one run each
• side panel: worktrees, previews, shipped, last command runs
• a shelf of projects can run a group run (see below)

sDeskPhone.text:
phone over adb — logic
• mirror + control over usb, or adb over wifi on the tailnet
• who drives: watch / you / the agent; agent taps drawn as rings
• install newest build, deep links, logcat, captures
• dev toggles via adb shell settings
• agent access = one switch, same as the phone app's setting

sQuestionCard.text:
question card — states
• single, multi, with previews, answered (collapses to the pick), expired (run moved on)
• one component on phone, desktop and notifications
• keyboard: 1–4 or a–d picks, enter sends
• 'recommended' only when the agent marks it

sQuestionTodo.text:
change to make
• 'pick one' can always become 'pick several': a small 'pick more than one' toggle under the options, even when the agent asked for one — the answer then goes back as a list, with a line telling the agent you chose several
• any question takes a note: 'add a note' under the options (type or say it), sent along with the pick — e.g. 'B, but keep the total visible'
• both work the same on phone, desktop and in notifications (there, the inline reply is the note)

sUsage.text:
usage — logic
• context: tokens in this chat vs the model's window; at 80% offers /compact
• plan limits: 5-hour and weekly windows per agent, with resets
• read from what each agent reports, else estimated from counted tokens
• limits can pause new runs and keep a reserve for daytime

sUsageCheck.text:
to check before building
• which usage numbers each agent actually exposes to another app (5h / weekly windows, reset times); if one doesn't, show cellar's own count and say it's an estimate
• providers' terms: openai's terms say not to circumvent rate limits, and anthropic added weekly limits citing account sharing — so switching is for accounts you own (personal, work seat, api key), and 'ask me' is the default
• antigravity is an ide; it needs a headless way to run before cellar can drive it

sAccounts.text:
accounts — logic
• each agent has a list: subscriptions, team seats, api keys
• a run uses one account; its sign-in lives in the run's own folder (CODEX_HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR), secrets in the os keychain — like codex-switcher, but per run, not global
• plan runs out: ask me (default) · next account · api key · the other agent · wait for reset
• the switch happens between turns: a fresh session on the new account, primed with the run's plan, diff and last messages

sRecipes.text:
recipes + rules — logic
• every entry kind has a recipe: agent, mode, / skills, prompt template, $ commands after
• all user-editable; new kinds start empty
• rule entries sync into AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md in a managed block, scoped everywhere → shelf → project
• each write shows a diff first; nothing outside the block changes

sHosts.text:
hosts — logic
• a host = anywhere the daemon runs: this pc, or any machine by an ssh link (user@host:port + key)
• cellar installs and updates the daemon over ssh
• per host: slots, night shift yes/no, which projects
• notification routing and quiet hours live here too

sGroupRun.text:
group runs — logic
• a group = any shelf or a hand-picked set of projects
• one task → one run per project: same prompt + each project's rules
• progress per project; review the same change side by side
• each project ships with its own $ commands

sSpec.text:
the three spec boards
• structure: sections, how the pieces talk, roadmap
• keys: @ files, $ commands and $project/entry, / agent skills, # colours — a task always names its project first, so search stays exact
• notes: how t3code hands work to agents, read from its source
